name: PMO Compliance Status
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Compliance Item:Link/PMO Compliance Item:220",
    obligation AS "Obligation:Link/PMO Compliance Obligation:240",
    period AS "Period:Data:120",
    due_date AS "Due Date:Date:110",
    completion_date AS "Completion Date:Date:130",
    compliance_status AS "Compliance Status:Data:170",
    remarks AS "Remarks:Small Text:260"
FROM `tabPMO Compliance Item`
ORDER BY
    CASE compliance_status
        WHEN 'Non-Compliant' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Partially Compliant' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Open' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Compliant' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END,
    due_date
